_readme: Festival calendar for @whoisaaniiiya. Entries with 'date' are fixed (same date every year, MM-DD). Lunar/moving festivals carry 'years': explicit ISO dates per year (extend when a new year approaches — lookup degrades gracefully to no-festival otherwise). Lunar dates are panchang-based and can shift a day by region/moon-sighting; the years map makes any fix a one-line edit. On a festival day the greeting line leads the caption (src/festivals.py decorates) and the festival tags ride right behind the static bank (trending.caption_tags). Line choice is deterministic per (date, id) so re-runs never rewrite a published caption. 'vibe' is informational (day-plan log) — the day's actual media keeps its own vibe. First matching entry wins on a same-day collision, so keep majors listed first. Never edit while a run is in flight.
